value.rationale: Uniform lower spacing is a natural operational case of constrained-subsequence universality. The result settles its complete index-refined enumerator for arbitrary finite alphabets and spacings, identifies an exact tractable subclass distinct from general constrained-hardness results, and fully classifies/counts shortest witnesses. This is an all-parameter structural theorem rather than a routine substitution or small isolated computation.
